# GrowthBook Product Leadership Demo
Date: 2026-11-23 | Duration: 30.920000076293945m

## Summary
ResMed stakeholders reviewed GrowthBook as a way to accelerate experimentation and result delivery, particularly as AI coding tools increase pressure to match experimentation velocity. GrowthBook supports PM-led experiment setup, including hypotheses, targeting, traffic allocation, primary and secondary metrics, and guardrails, while also supporting existing assignment tooling such as PEEP. Its warehouse-native analysis uses existing customer data, Bayesian testing, treatment-control comparisons, lift estimates, and rollback recommendations when guardrails deteriorate. Feature changes remain dependent on ResMed’s SDKs, CMS integrations, or internal systems. Front-end, server-side, and LLM experimentation are supported when configurable values are exposed, but Dawn is not yet ready for fine-grained response control; ResMed would need to define parameters and connect them to Dawn. Self-hosting and keeping data within customer systems address healthcare-related security requirements. Nitant Bhartia preferred minimizing dependence on PEEP, while ResMed planned an internal review and requested further information about Maya’s configurability and Khan Academy examples.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Experimentation, Feature Flags, Warehouse-Native Analytics, LLM Prompt Testing, ResMed
